title: SBI Tata Star Select credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: The Tata STAR Card Select is a premium co-branded credit card from Tata and SBI, offering up to 5% value back at STAR and Tata partner outlets, 3X rewards on dining, grocery, and international spends, and 8 complimentary domestic lounge visits annually. With a ₹2,999 annual fee, it includes a ₹3,500 welcome voucher and renewal vouchers on high annual spends ideal for shoppers loyal to STAR Bazaar and Tata brands.
